The '''Steniplis sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Steniplis sector was neutral.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] had a hideout called [[Black Stall Station/Legends|Black Stall Station]] in the [[Rogue Antar system/Legends|Rogue Antar system]] in the Steniplis sector. The coordinates of this station were 673117-7rb71.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Crime lord/Legends|lord]] [[Vangar]] was feared within the Steniplis sector, where his [[baseworld]] [[Prexiar]] was located.<ref name="Pirates">{{WEGCite|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded|story=The Pirates of Prexiar}}</ref>
